# foreman_computeresource (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_computeresource" "vmware" {
  name = "VMware Cluster ABC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the computeresource to look up.

### Read-Only

- `caching_enabled` (Boolean) enable caching, for VMware only
- `compute_resource_provider` (String) Providers include Libvirt, EC2, Vmware, Openstack
- `datacenter` (String) for VMware Datacenter
- `description` (String)
- `display_type` (String) for Libvirt only
- `domain` (String) for OpenStack (v3) only
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for EC2, VMware, OpenStack. Secret key for EC2
- `project_domain_id` (String) for OpenStack (v3) only
- `project_domain_name` (String) for OpenStack (v3) only
- `region` (String) for AzureRm eg. &#39;eastus&#39; and for EC2 only. Use &#39;us-gov-west-1&#39; for EC2 GovCloud region
- `server` (String) for VMware
- `set_console_password` (Boolean, Sensitive) for Libvirt and VMware only
- `tenant` (String) for OpenStack and AzureRm only
- `url` (String) URL for Libvirt and OpenStack
- `user` (String) Username for EC2, VMware, OpenStack. Access Key for EC2.
